summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Lowkey Home Page COMPLETE REDESIGN - new feed-style layout. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). All UI features verified working including HERO profile card, profile modal (NOT /search navigation), After Dark banner, Lounges chips, Quick Access, and Bottom Nav.
critical_code_review_comments: Stock photos from unsplash/pexels are used as fallback avatars for users without profile pictures - this is MOCKED/expected behavior
Recent Activity shows real member names with simulated status verbs (is browsing, just came online, is active now) when no real notifications exist - this is MOCKED/expected behavior
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 9+ users, 7 lounges, founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Complete home page redesign verified. New feed-style layout with: HERO profile card (aspect-ratio 3/4), Active Now overlapping avatars, Stories row, 2-column profile grids interleaved with content, Recent Activity with real member status, After Dark banner with Sparkles/LIVE/Enter arrow, Lounges horizontal pill chips, Quick Access (Radio/Games/Inbox), Credits link, Bottom Nav (Home/Lounge/After Dark/Profile). Profile modal opens correctly on all user clicks (NOT /search navigation).
